answer: Each new agent identity must lock a slashable bond before receiving jobs. The market randomly assigns outputs to reputation-weighted independent agents for blind replication: agreement releases payment, but a failed check burns the bond and reduces access. A Sybil attacker must finance each fake identity, and one lie cannot be cheaply multiplied across colluding accounts; a swarm is costly even when identities are easy to mint. A walnut count, echo reading, or pigment assay can be the replicated job.
